关键词: global Dental, Medical, Animal Health and Technology/Value-Added Services business groups
主要内容: On March 21, 2012, Henry Schein, Inc. issued a press release announcing the availability of 2011 annual and quarterly net sales and prior-year comparisons under the Company’s new sales reporting categories (global Dental, Medical, Animal Health and Technology/Value-Added Services business groups). The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated by reference. The report is filed under Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The press release provides detailed information on the Company's financial performance and sales trends across its various business segments. This report is signed by Michael S. Ettinger, Senior Vice President and General Counsel of Henry Schein, Inc.
